description: Test suite for Datev report generation in ERPNext, including setup functions and unit tests for CSV output and download functionality.

classes.name: TestDatev
classes.description: Unit test class for verifying Datev report functionalities, including setup, CSV generation, and download verification.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment by creating company, customer, item, settings, and a sales invoice.

methods.name: test_columns
methods.description: Checks that the data returned for transactions, customers, suppliers, and account names contain only allowed columns.

methods.name: test_header
methods.description: Verifies that the report headers include expected data categories.

methods.name: test_csv
methods.description: Generates a sample CSV data and verifies its creation.

methods.name: test_download
methods.description: Ensures that the download function returns a ZIP file.
